assessments.rationale: The passage explicitly reports delays for refrigerated orders, while clarifying that standard orders were on time.
The passage says standard orders met their promised delivery dates, contradicting the claim that they missed them.
The passage mentions refrigerated orders and their delays, but does not state that refrigerated fulfilment transports temperature-sensitive products.
The passage reports delays for refrigerated orders and says the report did not estimate lost revenue. It does not establish that the delays caused the merchant’s revenue decline.
The passage directly states that Opal Commerce observed a traffic increase during a public festival. It does not establish what caused the increase, but the claim does not assert a cause.
The passage says the analysts’ observations did not establish what caused the traffic increase, contradicting the claim that they established the festival caused it.
The passage mentions observed traffic at Opal Commerce but does not state that website analytics record visits to online stores.
The passage says the observations did not establish what caused the increase, so it does not support attributing the traffic increase to the festival.
